description: Search inspection logs by place, permit, type, result and date. Summaries and future scheduled inspections are excluded by default; upcoming and summaries opt in. Sources report data_through. Coverage varies by source and place; an empty result does not establish that no record exists. Up to 25 results per call. total_capped marks a lower bound; total_unknown means the total is unknown. Pagination guidance is in _notes.

city.description: City name (matches the address city or the issuing jurisdiction)

date_after.description: inspection_date on or after (undated inspections never match)

inspection_type.description: Normalised inspection type, e.g. FRAMING, ROUGH, FINAL

permit_number.description: The permit number, as the city publishes it or as /v1/permits returns it

result.description: PASS, FAIL, PARTIAL, CANCELLED, SCHEDULED or OTHER

scope.description: permit (default): inspections of permitted work. existing / occupancy: occupancy inspections of existing buildings that no permit asked for; all.

start.description: Instead of page: 1-based position of the first result to return, e.g. start=24 continues after result 23 (as named in `_notes`)

summaries.description: 'Last inspection' summaries copied from permit records (not inspection logs). Default exclude.

upcoming.description: Future-dated (still scheduled) inspections: exclude (the default, except with result=SCHEDULED), include, or only (soonest first).

name: search_inspections
title: Search building inspections
